objective: Evaluate exact EMPTY/DIRECT/PARENT routing from sealed M469/M470 sidecars only. Every K point is compared against a direct-only baseline with the identical K source-bank/product resource, block-bank axis, bandwidth and 240 KiB gates. No M410R2 derivative or M40 payload may be opened.

exact_route.empty: original16 popcount is zero: no source issue and no payload
exact_route.direct: bank-aware direct cycles=max(ceil(popcount(original16)/K), maximum modulo-8 source-bank occupancy)
exact_route.parent: bank-aware exact parent cycles=1+max(ceil(popcount(original16 XOR center)/K), maximum modulo-8 residual-bank occupancy)
exact_route.selection: If popcount<=K, route DIRECT. Otherwise route PARENT only when parent cycles are strictly smaller than direct cycles; ties route DIRECT.
exact_route.arithmetic_identity: W*x=PWP(center)+signed W*(x-center). The source and residual masks remain exact binary selectors over unchanged signed INT8 weights.
exact_route.parent_subset_proof: For popcount>K, direct is at least two cycles and dominates the at-most-two modulo-8 bank maximum. A strict parent-cycle win implies 1+Hamming(x,center)<popcount(x), so every G15 PARENT row is a subset of the frozen M430 use-PWP rows for the same best center.

resource_axes.same_k_direct_candidate_source_resource: 96*K physical product/source slots, K independent source banks or equivalent read ports, and 96*(K-1) signed preadder proxy. Candidate matcher/descriptor/PWP storage and commands are incremental and explicitly charged.

cycle_model.schedule: serial conservative ledger because G15 selected compute is sealed globally but not per row-tile task; no DMA, matcher, generator or compute overlap is credited
cycle_model.direct_per_task: (row_count+5)*block_passes source scan + two natural half-weight DMAs when nonempty + exact global direct issue cycles*8 + tail + commit
cycle_model.candidate_per_task: empty uses source scan only; nonempty uses frozen M430 early matcher*block_passes, config DMA per pass, two natural half payloads, descriptor latency, exact global selected issue cycles*8, tail and commit
cycle_model.block_passes: 8 resident banks use one scan/matcher pass and two replay halves; 4 resident banks repeat source/config/matcher for two complete half passes

conservative_upper_bounds.replacement: Use each task's sealed M430 used-center mask/runs for stored-PWP bytes/commands and lazy generation cycles/reads/writes.
conservative_upper_bounds.why_upper_bound: The exact-route subset proof makes the M430 parent-row center set a superset of G15's selected center set.
conservative_upper_bounds.matcher: Charge the full frozen M430 early matcher for every nonempty candidate task, even though popcount<=K DIRECT rows need no parent search.

traffic_and_capacity.psum_sram_accesses: all active rows update eight output blocks; report reads and writes at 228 bytes/vector
traffic_and_capacity.capacity_source: Reuse the sealed R6 per-mode logical and conservative macro-rounded capacity items without reinterpretation.
traffic_and_capacity.required_fit: both R6 logical and macro-rounded <=240 KiB gates

decision_rule.baseline: For each K, resident-block-bank axis and bandwidth, independently select the minimum-cycle direct-only point among row tiles that pass both 240 KiB gates.
decision_rule.nominate: Candidate must pass both gates and achieve >=1.15x versus that same-K/banks/bandwidth best-budget direct-only baseline.
decision_rule.rtl: CPU DSE may nominate only; no RTL or performance admission before independent hammer.

failure_policy: Strict JSON, exact-SHA, no overwrite and preserve failures.
Do not read M410R2 rows, M40 manifests or M40 payloads.
Do not compare different K values as same-resource.
Do not call M430 center-mask traffic exact G15 traffic.
